findings.title: Punishment and mercy have procedural gates
findings.claim: Within the declared 5:27-5:40 pericope, the focus pair of punishment and forgiveness is procedurally contoured: timing before human capture, deterrent punishment, and repentance joined to repair give the two actions local operating gates.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers يُعَذِّبُ at 5:40:9:1 and يَغْفِرُ at 5:40:12:2 contact the pericope's temporal and capacity boundary at 5:34:5/7, the deterrent penalty at 5:38:8, and the repair and protective forgiveness sequence at 5:39:6/13. These contacts make timing, deterrence, repair, and protection operative contours around the focus pair.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the focus places punishment and forgiveness beside its closing power assertion: the surrounding legal sequence gives each side a concrete mode of operation without making either side the sole rule.
findings.containment: This does not claim that 5:34-5:39 exhausts divine willing or that the focus pair is reducible to legal conditions; the supplied alternative is that these may be separate legal conditions. The three unresolved contextual branches remain attributed HFT evidence, and their lexical identities are not expanded.

epistemic.reason: The focus and pericope Arabic contacts are supplied exactly, while the nomination source is legacy_unbound HFT evidence. Accepted or qualified focus branches support the core relation; unresolved contextual branch descriptors are carried only as attributed traces.

findings.title: Earth becomes a material image of protective covering
findings.claim: Within the pericope, the earth named inside God's dominion can function as the material medium through which exposed ruin is covered, giving the focus's forgiveness a concrete image of protection.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers أَرْضِ at 5:40:8:3 and يَغْفِرُ at 5:40:12:2 contact 5:31's earth, disturbance, repeated covering, and exposed shame at 5:31:4/6/9/10/20/21. The earth scene therefore gives the protective side of forgiveness a material analogy of putting exposed damage under cover.
findings.reader_payoff: Forgiveness becomes perceptible not only as cancellation but as protection that places exposed damage out of view, while the earth remains an active teaching medium.
findings.containment: Burial concealment is not forgiveness itself. This remains a material analogy for protective covering, not an equation of burial with absolution; the unresolved contextual branches remain attributed and receive no invented lexical gloss or facet.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 5:31 surface coordinates are supplied, but the nomination is legacy_unbound HFT evidence, the payload labels the reading exploratory, and three contextual branch descriptors are unresolved.

findings.title: The host opening frames forgiveness as mercy
findings.claim: The host basmala's paired mercy names give the focus forgiveness predicate a protective-mercy frame within the surah.

findings.reader_payoff: The closing choice to forgive is heard as a sheltering act within the host's opening disposition, while the focus's explicit will structure remains visible.
findings.containment: This adds a host-surah frame to the focus's forgiveness; it does not turn mercy into a lexical gloss of غ ف ر, infer a condition for forgiveness, or replace the focus's stated will clause.

epistemic.reason: The host basmala and focus surface are exact packet evidence, but the relation between mercy and forgiveness is a bounded cross-root contextual inference rather than a supplied branch nomination.

findings.title: Sovereignty reaches the judgment day

findings.mechanism: The focus carrier مُلْكُ at 5:40:6:1 contacts the same-root external owner at 1:4:1 and the paired day-and-recompense terms at 1:4:2/3. The ownership and sovereignty branches therefore meet a specific judgment-day trigger, extending the focus domain across spatial and temporal rule.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing power assertion gains a concrete horizon: the one who holds the cosmic domain is encountered where recompense is administered.
findings.containment: The overlay does not replace the focus's heavens-earth domain, collapse مُلْكُ and مَالِكِ into identical forms, or import an unsupplied whole-surah eschatology beyond 1:4.

epistemic.reason: The focus and the individually supplied 1:4 surface/root occurrences are exact packet evidence; the ownership-to-sovereignty extension is a bounded external contextual resonance.
